title: PPIA-15 Awkward Regression Case Taxonomy and Test Dimensions

taxonomy_families.definition: Authority, entitlement, hidden existence, revocation and minimum-disclosure edges.
Simultaneous intent, expected-version conflict, stale editors, duplicate operations and incompatible updates.
Disconnect, reconnect, status-unknown, accepted Event/projection lag, interrupted flows and safe retry.
Bounded deterministic high-cardinality fixtures that stress selection, projection, navigation and semantic accessibility without becoming product limits.
Keyboard, screen-reader/nonvisual, high-zoom/text-scale, reduced-motion and noncolor semantic/task parity.
Phone/tablet, touch-only and compact single-focus flows where task sequencing differs from wide desktop presentation.
Stable-ID identity, duplicate names, Definition versus instance, source-only versus instantiated state, unusual forms and cross-owner transfers.
Cases spanning owning domains where accepted Events, reveal/approval, Campaign-local scope, provenance and nonpromotion boundaries must remain intact.

required_awkward_families.required_differential: two authorized actors select or act on the same stable object/state before either client observes the other's result
reveal state changes while the live session and cached projections are already open
entitlement or permission is valid at entry and revoked while protected projections/actions are cached
do not duplicate baseline GM modification; only add a case when modification combines with stale state, reconnect, hidden state or another unproven edge
multiple visible objects share a display name but must remain distinguishable by stable identity/provenance without unsafe hidden metadata
two edits or operations collide on expected version and require current-version/status recovery rather than silent last-write-wins
a Campaign-local override collides with inherited/source state and must remain local with explicit provenance
a reusable source Definition is visible/selectable without an owned/Campaign/live instance and must not be silently instantiated or promoted
Vehicle ownership/custody/control/crew/cargo relations change through a transfer edge without collapsing distinct authority relations
a protected relationship/claim/secret becomes visible to a bounded audience while topology/counts/other recipients remain nonleaking
a Rune/crafting or analogous governed construction flow is interrupted between local draft/proposal/approval/accepted authoritative state without fabricating completion
actor reconnects while an approval decision may have happened; status/current authority are re-resolved before retry or display
bounded high-cardinality Item/Asset fixture stresses identity, search/selection, hidden aggregates and accessible navigation
bounded high-cardinality Creature/NPC/encounter fixture stresses semantic targeting, permission-safe counts and accessible navigation without asserting a production capacity
nonhuman/nonstandard morphology or form must remain semantically complete without human-body defaults, silent compatibility synthesis or inaccessible controls
complete a workflow using a compact/touch path whose sequencing is materially different from wide desktop, not a viewport-only clone
complete an awkward conflict/recovery/object-edge flow without drag/spatial-only/icon-only dependence and with equivalent semantic status
offline/read-only state permits only explicitly bounded local/read behavior; canonical mutation, hidden-state expansion and fabricated authoritative Events remain prohibited

scale_rule: Scale labels are QA dimensions only. Every stress case must declare its concrete synthetic fixture size, but no fixture size becomes a product capacity, performance, support or release promise.
dimension_requirements: Every new scenario names at least one required awkward family and one material differential from its nearest inherited anchor.
Every scenario names actor role, context, device/interaction mode, authority precondition and expected safe oracle.
Protected-state scenarios resolve permission/entitlement before counts, search, selection, actions, diagnostics, exports, notifications, support or AI context.
Visual and nonvisual variants must preserve semantic outcome and disclosure ceiling.
AI is a service actor over the already-authorized projection and never an oracle authority or required core path.
F024 Pack Lifecycle remains unsupported until upstream authority exists.
